**Chase music whenever an AI drives your Mac.** 🎷🥔

**Install (one line in Terminal):**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mhrtly/chase-scene/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or download **Chase-Scene.zip** below, unzip it and drag **Chase Scene** to Applications. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time you open it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** (on macOS 13–14 you can also Control-click the app and choose **Open**).

Universal app for macOS 13 Ventura and later (Apple silicon and Intel). See the [README](https://github.com/mhrtly/chase-scene#readme) for what it does and how.
